notes: belongeth unto is the lamed's own rendering under rule 49's verb-of-belonging clause, headed on the English preposition, exactly as asher la-bayith gives which belonged to; the construction's copula joins the relative, which is the clause's predicate anchor (rule 20). Heading the relative on which rather than that was the competing reading.

upon in wait upon the service is the preposition through which the English verb reaches its bare cognate object (rule 44), as the margin's literal to war the warfare confirms; no Hebrew preposition stands there.
maalah fuses its directive he with the host under rules 30 and 32; the waw between the numerals takes the written and under rule 42.
